reviews.text: MEDIPEEL Peptide 9 Volume Lif-Tox Eye Cream is a firming eye treatment that targets wrinkles and loss of elasticity with consistent use. I noticed the rich but lightweight texture absorbs well without feeling heavy, and the 9-peptide complex works to plump and lift the under-eye area while smoothing fine lines. It feels nourishing and hydrating, yet it layers nicely under makeup and doesn’t pill. The formula is suitable for daily use morning and night, and the 20ml tube lasts a while with regular use. It’s a solid choice if you want an eye cream that focuses on volume, firmness, and a more lifted, youthful look.
reviews.zh: MEDIPEEL Peptide 9 Volume Lif-Tox Eye Cream 係一款緊緻眼部護理產品，持續使用可針對皺紋同彈性流失。我留意到質地豐潤但輕盈，吸收得好好，唔會覺得厚重。9 種肽嘅複合配方可以令眼周飽滿、提拉，同時撫平幼紋。用嚟好滋養、補水，而且喺化妝底下都舒服，唔會搓泥。每日早晚都可以用，20 毫升嘅軟管持續用都夠用幾耐。如果你想要一款專注於飽滿、緊緻、令眼周更提升、更年輕嘅眼霜，呢款係一個好選擇。

reviews.text:
I really like this eye cream when I want something that feels more like a treatment than just a basic moisturizer for the eye area. The formula has that smooth, nourishing texture that makes the eye area feel comfortable and moisturized, and I particularly enjoy using it when my under-eyes feel a little tired or dehydrated.

What makes this product interesting is the peptide-focused formula and the brand’s emphasis on firming, lifting and improving the appearance of the eye area. MEDI-PEEL describes it as a high-performance Lif-Tox eye cream designed to visibly depuff, lift and firm, and it’s also designed to be used with a cooling massage technique.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢款眼霜，當我想要一款比起普通保濕霜更似「療程」嘅眼部護理產品時，我會用佢。配方質地順滑、滋養，令眼部感覺舒服同保濕，我特別鍾意喺眼下有啲疲倦或者脫水嗰陣用。

呢款產品有趣嘅地方，係佢以肽為重點嘅配方，同埋品牌強調緊緻、提拉同改善眼部外觀。MEDI-PEEL 形容佢係高效能 Lif-Tox 眼霜，設計嚟可以即時明顯消腫、提拉同緊緻，而且仲設計咗要配合冷卻按摩手法使用。

reviews.text:
Excellent daytime plumping & hydration!
Review: This eye cream is fantastic for deep hydration and a visible "plumping" effect. The texture is a bit unique (slightly stretchy at first), but it absorbs beautifully once tapped in. Being in my 40s and using strong actives and regular micro-needling at night, I need something highly soothing and barrier-supporting for the daytime. The peptides and panthenol make this incredibly calming. It fills in dehydration lines perfectly and stops my concealer from creasing, even in extreme heat. Don't expect it to erase deep dark circles, but for volume, elasticity, and hydration, it’s a 10/10!
reviews.zh:
日間飽滿保濕效果出色！
評測：呢款眼霜對深層補水同明顯嘅「飽滿」效果都好好。質地有啲特別（一開始有少少拉絲感），但係一拍入皮膚就吸收得好好。我四十幾歲，夜晚會用好多有效成分，同埋定期做微針，所以日間需要好舒緩、支持屏障嘅產品。肽同泛醇令佢非常舒緩。佢完美填補咗脫水紋，又令遮瑕唔會因為天氣好熱而卡紋。雖然唔會消除深黑眼圈，但係論飽滿、彈性同保濕，我俾 10/10！

reviews.text:
I’ve been using the MEDIPEEL+ Peptide 9 Volume Lif-Tox Eye Cream for a bit now, and I’m honestly so impressed.
​My under-eyes can get super dry, but this stuff is intensely hydrating without feeling heavy or greasy. It sinks in quickly, works amazingly under concealer (zero pilling!), and leaves the skin looking plump, smooth, and genuinely refreshed. It’s rare to find an eye cream that actually delivers this much moisture and makes you look well-rested. Definitely a keeper!
reviews.zh:
我用咗 MEDIPEEL+ Peptide 9 Volume Lif-Tox Eye Cream 一段時間，真係好驚喜。
我嘅眼下好容易非常乾，但係呢款好滋潤，唔會覺得厚重或油膩。好快吸收，喺遮瑕下面效果好好（完全冇搓泥！），令皮膚睇落飽滿、順滑，仲真係有清新感。好難搵到一款眼霜可以咁提供保濕，又令你睇落休息得好。絕對值得留返！

reviews.text: I’ve been using this eye cream for a while and I like it mainly for its comfort and hydration. The texture is rich but not heavy, and it absorbs nicely without leaving a greasy layer. My under-eye area feels smoother and more elastic, especially when my skin is dry or tired. It works well under makeup and doesn’t cause irritation or eye watering, which is a big plus for me. I don’t treat it as a “botox-like” product, but as a solid peptide eye cream that helps keep the eye area hydrated, soft, and well cared for. I’d say it’s a good everyday option, especially for mature skin.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款眼霜一段時間，我主要鍾意佢嘅舒適同補水效果。質地豐潤但唔重，吸收得好好，唔會留低油膩嘅一層。當我皮膚乾或疲倦嗰陣，我眼下嘅位置會睇起嚟更加平滑、更有彈性。佢喺化妝下面都好用，而且唔會令眼睛刺激或流眼水，對我嚟講係一大優點。我唔會當佢係「肉毒桿菌」咁嘅產品，而係當做一款穩陣嘅肽眼霜，有助保持眼部濕潤、柔軟、護理得好。我會話佢係一個好嘅日常選擇，特別係對成熟肌膚。

reviews.text: I appreciate the eye cream's rich yet non-greasy formula, which provides intense hydration to the skin around the eyes. The cream contains a blend of peptides, which are amino acid compounds known for their ability to stimulate collagen production and improve skin elasticity. This can help to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, giving the eye area a smoother and more youthful appearance.
reviews.zh: 我好欣賞呢款眼霜嘅豐潤但唔油膩配方，為眼周皮膚提供強效補水。呢款面霜含有一系列肽，即係已知可以刺激膠原蛋白生成、改善皮膚彈性嘅氨基酸化合物。呢啲可以幫助減少幼紋同皺紋嘅出現，令眼部睇落更平滑、更年輕。

reviews.text: I appreciate the luxurious yet lightweight texture of the Peptide 9 Volume Lif-Tox Eye Cream. It's designed to provide intense hydration to the delicate skin around the eyes without feeling heavy or greasy. The cream contains a blend of peptides, which are amino acid compounds known for their ability to stimulate collagen production and improve skin elasticity. This can help to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, giving the eye area a smoother and more youthful appearance. Cream has metal cooling end, nice for massage.
reviews.zh: 我好欣賞 Peptide 9 Volume Lif-Tox Eye Cream 嘅奢華而輕盈嘅質地。佢設計嚟可以為眼周嘅幼嫩皮膚提供強效補水，唔會覺得厚重或油膩。呢款面霜含有一系列肽，即係已知可以刺激膠原蛋白生成、改善皮膚彈性嘅氨基酸化合物。呢啲可以幫助減少幼紋同皺紋嘅出現，令眼部睇落更平滑、更年輕。面霜有金屬冷卻頭，好啱按摩用。
